about_the_game:
The 4th paid DLC for MASH VP! Re:VISION is here!

Featuring tracks from the AXTORM MUSIC album “GENESiS RE:BUiLD 03”, centered around the theme of space and stars!

Also includes a triple mashup track that fuses a brand-new original song with two fan favorites!

As a download bonus, a new game background is added as a play customization item!

The DLC includes “GRWM,” the second original MASH VP! Re:VISION track by popular artist TORIENA,

as well as the UK hardcore track “Get Rockin’” by KO3 & Relect!

Also featured is the fantastical “星屑の花びら” by Tatsh feat. Kiyommy!

In addition to songs from GENESiS RE:BUiLD 03, two more popular tracks by 立秋 feat. ちょこ, “竹” and “田中”, join the lineup!

These two songs, combined with the brand-new track “ACID 4 TRICK / Tatsh,” create a triple mashup that’s even more challenging and unpredictable for players!

The following tracks will be added to FREE PLAY mode:

  • GRWM / TORIENA

  • Get Rockin’ / KO3 & Relect

  • 星屑の花びら / Tatsh feat. Kiyommy

  • 世が明けるまで / 謎のユニット

  • XROSS BASS / Quarkee

  • Pleiades / MiYAjY

  • 孤独と衝動 / セガール大佐 feat. 北條響

  • BlindedByTheWater / Usnow

  • 竹 / 立秋 feat.ちょこ

  • 田中 / 立秋 feat.ちょこ

  • ACID 4 TRICK / Tatsh

  • luv again / Android52

Additional mashup tracks will also be added to MASH UP mode:

  • "ACID 4 TRICK / Tatsh" x "竹 / 立秋 feat.ちょこ" x "田中 / 立秋 feat.ちょこ"

  • "GRWM / TORIENA" x "off duty / TORIENA"

  • "Get Rockin’ / KO3 & Relect" x "luv again / Android52"

  • "GRWM / TORIENA" x "Get Rockin’ / KO3 & Relect"

  • "Make My Day / Hmt2 feat. ChumuNote" x "Get Rockin’ / KO3 & Relect"

As a download bonus, a new game background theme will also be added!

※ ‘Make My Day / Hmt2 feat. ChumuNote’ × ‘Get Rockin’ / KO3 & Relect’

This mashup track is available to play by purchasing the DLC “MASH VP! Re:VISION - GENESiS REBUiLD 03 STARDUST.”

While “Make My Day” is included in the DLC “MASH VP! Re:VISION - AXTORM SOUND RELATION -I- beginning,”

you must purchase “GENESiS REBUiLD 03 STARDUST” to play this mashup.

Please note that owning “AXTORM SOUND RELATION -I- beginning” alone does not grant access to the mashup track.
